subject: Helio Health renewal – capacity acceleration, term adjustment & procurement gateway
messages:
From: Emma Stevens <emma.stevens@heliohealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Diaz <c.diaz@heliohealth.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity bump — Helio procurement kickoff

Hi Lauren,

Hope you had a good week — we're ready to move on our upcoming renewal and would like to accelerate a portion of the capacity uplift earlier in the term.

High-level ask: increase committed token capacity by 40% starting July 1, 2029, extend term 12 -> 18 months, and lock pricing for the first 12 months of the extended term. Procurement is asking for a refreshed vendor onboarding package and PO to be submitted via your procurement gateway.

I've attached: PO_Template_Helio_2029.pdf and SOW_Helio_v2.docx.

Can we get a short mutual action plan and a portal invite for our procurement team? We need to align legal redlines and SOC2 evidence handoff too.

Thanks — Emma

Emma Stevens
Head of Vendor Ops, Helio Health
emma.stevens@heliohealth.com
+1 415-555-0192

Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity bump — Helio procurement kickoff

Emma — thanks for the clear ask and for the attachments. Quick proposal below to keep timelines tight: 

- Week 1 (Jun 3–7): legal redline pass + procurement portal invite (we need your procurement team's contact list).
- Week 2 (Jun 10–14): finalize SOW and PO amounts; Redwood legal issues redlines doc back.
- Week 3 (Jun 17–21): DocuSign + portal PO submission; target effective date Jul 1 for the first uplift tranche.

Numbers: Jordan and I ran models and validated a 40% committed uplift; I'll include a line-item breakout in the MAP (mutual action plan) and shared spreadsheet. I've attached MAP_HELIO_2029.xlsx with the suggested phasing and expected monthly token burn.

Portal: I can issue the procurement gateway invite to procurement@heliohealth.com today once you confirm the contact. We'll also include our SOC2 evidence bundle and the audit onboarding steps in the portal.

Karthik — looping you in for the legal redline cadence and the 18-month term change (we expect a few contract tweaks around data residency and termination caps).

Next steps for Emma: share procurement contact and confirm you want pricing locked for 12 months within the extended term.

Best,
Lauren

Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity bump — Helio procurement kickoff

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed SOW_Helio_v2.docx and the term change request. High level legal notes: 

1) Term extension to 18 months — acceptable but request a clause that preserves Redwood's SLA credits on capacity availability for the additional months.
2) Pricing lock for 12 months — fine; we need a clear definition of what constitutes "pricing" (per-token vs per-embedding) to avoid scope creep.
3) Data residency redline — suggest a short addendum limiting any data egress requests and defining audit window for evidence.

I'll attach a redlines document with tracked changes and the suggested addendum. Please confirm Helio's procurement contact(s) and whether your legal will accept an electronic signature flow (DocuSign).

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Emma — quick heads up on pricing so procurement can budget: the 40% uplift phased over three tranches (Jul, Sep, Nov) comes to a committed PO of $145,000 for the first 12 months after the uplift, with unit rate locked as discussed. We'll include an optional capacity burst pool for uncommitted traffic at a reduced overage rate.

If procurement confirms the PO amount and the contact for the portal invite, we'll flip the DocuSign packet same day.

—Jordan
